name: The Lodhi-Shima-Shi
insider_take: A sophisticated urban oasis where contemporary luxury meets India's rich cultural heritage in the heart of the diplomatic enclave.
whats_special: The Lodhi sits on 7 acres of manicured gardens in Lutyens' Delhi, featuring stunning views of the 15th-century Lodhi Gardens tombs. This Leading Hotels property boasts India's largest hotel suites and houses acclaimed restaurants by Michelin-starred chefs, making it a culinary destination in its own right.
pro_tip: Book a garden-facing room for sunrise views over the ancient Lodhi tombs, and time your visit during Delhi's pleasant winter months (November-February) when the hotel's expansive outdoor spaces truly shine.
dont_miss: A morning jog through the adjacent Lodhi Gardens archaeological park, cocktails at the rooftop bar overlooking medieval monuments, and dinner at Elan for contemporary Indian cuisine. The hotel's location puts you minutes from India Gate and the vibrant Khan Market.
pros: Private plunge pools in select suites and villas offer an exclusive resort-within-a-city experience
Prime location steps from the historic Lodhi Garden and close to Delhi's diplomatic and cultural hubs
Exceptional dining at Elan and The Lodhi Grill, celebrated as some of New Delhi's finest restaurants
Expansive, beautifully appointed rooms and suites among the largest in the city
World-class spa and wellness facilities with an impressive outdoor pool set within lush tropical gardens
cons: Ultra-luxury price point places it among Delhi's most premium accommodations
Located in South Delhi, requiring travel time to reach Old Delhi's historic monuments and markets
